card.name: Body-part words in adverse effect lists
card.fires_on: Body-tissue words like muscle, bone, lymph or joints (and the commas or 'and' just after them) inside lists of symptoms or side effects.

modes.label: Tissue word starting a symptom
modes.description: A tissue name such as bone, muscle or lymph opens the next symptom in a list of adverse effects.
modes.example: fatigue,<< muscle>> or joint aches, blisters,

modes.label: Punctuation inside symptom list
modes.description: A comma or 'and' right after a body-part symptom, before the next item in the list.
modes.example: pain in the joints<<,>> and loss of appetite.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a body-system or tissue term that comes next in the list, such as growth or shedding.
card.plain: It lights up in lists of side effects when a body part like muscle or bone is named.
